# Oracle response reliability remediation — reviewed plan

## Goal, authority and exclusions
Owner authorizes plan, Advisor adversarial review, TODO creation/update, then implementation and BenchBox PR closeout. Reviewer receives a JSON response TEMPLATE TO POPULATE, not an example. Preserve fail-closed decisions, evidence requirements, simplicity and role-based OMP routing. No ship-no-ship/local-executor work, stand-ins, bypasses, new Jev judge, model tier changes or owner settings/secrets edits.

Advisor OraclePlanAdvisor reviewed code at 7f5cd9b6b and approved implementation with C1–C12 corrections, incorporated here. Findings: duplicate JSON keys can erase defects; a broad SWF guard would break follow-up scoping; unfilled placeholders can look like valid paths; redaction must run before AND after text transformations, before truncation. These corrections are accepted. The initial report's proposed example is superseded by the owner's template requirement. Its filtered-read false-negative diagnosis is not established by retained traces: computed ?q= output remains uncredited.

L1: tolerate known harmless shape drift, retry eligible absence once, fix read presentation/diagnostics and template clarity. L2: preserve every decision-bearing field, protect replay and artifacts, reject placeholders/duplicate keys, contain known credential echoes without claiming a sandbox. L3: fix the model-to-code API boundary rather than add another model to reinterpret decisions.

## Prior art and recorded decisions
Extend verdict.validate/parse_output, runner.review, selection.next_step, attempts.replay, evidence.trace/unread/check, absence redaction and render.assemble_values. No parallel retry architecture or new service.
Explicitly supersede `_project/decisions/oracle-review-protocol-2026-10-08.md:31-42`: an actually empty SWF is no longer promoted to SHIP, and Codex's retired mandatory-property rationale does not justify ingress rejection of known harmless drift. Preserve :43-55 partial-read tripwire and :62-68 follow-up scoping. Reconcile `_project/decisions/oracle-review-v2-shadow-2026-10-05.md` strict schema statements. Update `docs/internal/oracle-review-v2.md` Decisions :263-291, Evidence :308-336, Calibration :397-406, Harness :408-427. Preserve all-severity blocking, citation marking, verified withdrawals, scope/carry rules, artifact provenance, quota backoff, trusted checkouts and genuine recorded harness fixtures.
Existing TODOs remain separate and are updated with delivered subset or explicit retained scope: oracle-read-evidence-tightening-20261008 (out-of-bounds/notice-only reads), oracle-verdict-labels-unreviewed-bytes (binary/unreviewable content), ci-oracle-reviewer-availability-and-head-race, oracle-reviewer-coverage-incomplete-on-large-diffs, oracle-coverage-gate-large-prs-20261017, oracle-muse-invalid-verdict-output-20261009, actions-runner-queue-oracle-latency-20261009, oracle-reviewer-backend-capacity. Do not close unrelated criteria. Gate-consumer migration is outside this response-remediation plan and remains its existing unlocked TODO.

## Evidence already obtained and limitations
Current code reproduced rejecting a complete SWF missing summary/incomplete_reason. Corpus check in the integrator worktree observed 302 valid stored verdicts, 118 with retained original plans: 57 SHIP, 58 SWF, 3 DO_NOT_SHIP. Four invalid diagnostics parse as full JSON, but only one remains structurally invalid: PR3237 run39662535698. These numbers describe the available corpus, not a current production success rate. The Advisor's claim that /tmp/ovart disappeared is rejected: parent read and executed replay over it successfully. Preserve actual artifacts outside repo and fetch both named PR3237 runs before retention expires. Synthetic reconstructions must be labelled synthetic, never recorded evidence.
Local actual runner.review smoke: omp18.12.6, @smol, head7f5cd9b6b, plain >100-line runner.py read returned details.summary {lines:64,elidedSpans:7,elidedLines:107}; reviewer reported incomplete. q=.version read returned one character. This proves source summaries harm review and queries can expose almost nothing. It does not prove CI pinned linux build/config parity. OMP_AGENT_CONFIG secret is unavailable locally; after-merge CI observation is required.

## Common invariants
1. Normalization only at reviewer ingress; stored artifacts remain strictly validated, never silently repaired.
2. No finding, severity/location, status/decision, prior status/evidence is dropped/invented. Unknown top-level keys, missing decision fields, extra JSON/prose, duplicate keys and unsafe placeholders fail closed.
3. DO_NOT_SHIP blocks; any counted/carried finding blocks. Existing out-of-scope-only SWF can still yield SHIP with not-counted disclosure.
4. One extra same-reviewer attempt after eligible absence; never resample a valid verdict. Keep run slot cap and quota/auth/timeout exclusions.
5. Evidence remains partial-read exposure, not whole-file or semantic proof. Directory/multi-path grep match metadata does not credit files.
6. Raw event streams and live credentials are not uploaded. Exact redaction is known-value hygiene, not a defense against arbitrary obfuscation or a secret-read sandbox.
